item.title: Tree planting
item.description: The first AI... that plants trees 🌳 From today, every subscriber helps Fabric plant mangrove trees in Brazil and Kenya. Mangrove trees are amazing because they protect shorelines, store carbon, and shelter marine life. Good tools leave things better than they found them, and that's what we aspire to be at Fabric.
